hints.title: Extract Non-Negative Values
hints.text: Extract all values >= 0 along with their original indices.

hints.title: Cyclic Rotation by k
hints.text: Rotate the non-negative elements list to the right by k % len(non_negatives) positions.

hints.title: Write Back to Original Indices
hints.text: Place the rotated non-negative values back into their original indices in nums.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def rotateNonNegative(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
        indices = [i for i, x in enumerate(nums) if x >= 0]
        if not indices:
            return nums
        
        m = len(indices)
        k %= m
        vals = [nums[i] for i in indices]
        rotated = vals[-k:] + vals[:-k]
        
        res = list(nums)
        for idx, val in zip(indices, rotated):
            res[idx] = val
        return res
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Attempting in-place shifts without index collection complicates boundary conditions.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Requires O(n) temporary space for non-negative values.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects clean index collection, cyclic shift modulo length, and scatter back.
